t: Abbud created the Supreme Council of the Armed Forces to rule Sudan, removing decision making from civilian politicians. The council included officers affiliated with both the Ansar and the Khatmiyyah.
أنشأ عبود المجلس الأعلى للقوات المسلحة لحكم السودان، وضم ضباطاً من الأنصار والختمية.

t: The regime profited from settling the Nile waters dispute with Egypt and improving relations between the two countries. It also marketed the cotton crop successfully in its first year.

t: In 1959 dissident officers made three attempts to topple the Abbud government. Their leaders were sentenced to life imprisonment, and the Sudanese Communist Party, which backed the attempts, gained a reputation as an effective opposition.
في 1959 قام ضباط منشقون بثلاث محاولات لإسقاط حكومة عبود، وحُكم على قادتها بالسجن المؤبد.

t: Abd al Wahab was removed in March 1959; until then the Ansar were the stronger group in the government. Ansar leader Abd ar Rahman al Mahdi died in early 1959.
